channel.title: AI GridWatch — Nebraska data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Nebraska, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Data center opposition is growing, with Nebraskans crossing party lines in protest
item.description: Via Nebraska Public Media

item.title: Gage County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Board of Supervisors approved 8-month moratorium on data center permits; P&Z Commission had recommended 18 months on Jun 16. Public hearing Sep 3 on extending to 18 months; board said decision within two weeks

item.title: Lancaster County: data center moratorium — Withdrawn
item.description: County halted moratorium plans Sep 10 after Bold Nebraska filed zoning code text amendment application. Board formed data center and industrial zoning task forces instead. Commissioner Flowerday noted an effective moratorium already exists since very little land is zoned industrial

item.title: Otoe County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: One-year moratorium on data center permits; first Nebraska county to pass a moratorium. Board Chairman Jerad Sornson appointed review committee to update comprehensive development plan

item.title: Butler County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Six-month moratorium on data centers; applies only to six townships under county zoning control (Hanover, Lemon, Madison, Milford, Oxford, Ross)

item.title: Box Butte County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Data center moratorium; one of the first wave of NE county moratoriums (enacted before Jul 16 2026)

item.title: Kearney County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Data center moratorium on unincorporated land; one of the first wave of NE county moratoriums (enacted before Jul 16 2026). City of Kearney (Buffalo County) took opposite approach, allowing DCs with restrictions

item.title: Logan County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium on data centers, wind/solar energy systems, and cryptocurrency mining; 12th NE county moratorium. County redoing comprehensive plan and zoning regulations

item.title: Cass County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium on data center permits, 5-0 vote. Proposed regulations postponed to Sep 22

item.title: Cherry County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Six-month moratorium on all conditional use permits (not data-center-specific but intended to slow data center development)

item.title: Nehawka: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Indefinite ban on data centers, crypto mining, blockchain computing, and power plants to run them; first municipality in Nebraska to pass an outright ban. Cited as blueprint by residents of Union, Murray, and Plattsmouth

item.title: Garfield County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Planning commission voted in favor of moratorium; awaiting county board final vote

item.title: Hall County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Board of Commissioners debated 180-day moratorium on data center rezoning and construction permits; vote outcome not confirmed

item.title: Seward County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month pause on all data center construction, permits and special-use conditions, unanimous with two commissioners absent. Ends early if the planning board and commissioners adopt regulations first. Board chair Misty Ahmic cited water and electrical infrastructure, noise, roads and decommissioning. One of at least ten Nebraska counties with a pause in place
